say:1:1230170201:1.text: Carmine Whispers aren't the only ones to blame. The Dead Tide Fleet is at fault too.
say:1:1230170201:1.source_cn: 不止血薇帮。是血薇帮和死潮舰队。

say:2:1230170202:1.text: The sea is shrouded in thick fog and plagued with sea monsters. Countless ships have gone missing.
say:2:1230170202:1.source_cn: 海上弥漫着迷雾，还有海怪出没，使得无数出海的船只至今未回。

say:3:1230170203:1.text: Meanwhile, the gangs in Rustport only care about their power!
say:3:1230170203:1.source_cn: 而锈锚港的帮派在这种时候却只想着争夺地盘！

say:4:1230170204:1.text: My old friends who went out to sea have yet to return. *Sigh*...
say:4:1230170204:1.source_cn: 我那些出海的旧友们都没回来，唉……
